title: Reviewing Adequacy of Drainage Systems following Flash Floods Due To Recent Monsoon Surges
what_it_is: Reviewing Adequacy of Drainage Systems following Flash Floods Due To Recent Monsoon Surges

sections.label: Flooding areas and Ministry strategy
sections.summary: MP asks how many areas flooded at three depths, how many flooded before, and the Ministry's strategy.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment in light of the monsoon surges in January 2025 (a) how many different areas reported flooding of (i) up to 0.5 metre (ii) between 0.5 and 1 metre and (iii) more than 1 metre above ground level; (b) out of these areas, how many have reported previous incidents of flooding in the past five years; and (c) what is the Ministry’s strategy to prevent and respond to flooding situations going forward.

sections.label: Changi rainfall 10-11 January
sections.summary: From 10 to 11 January, 255.2 millimetres of rainfall was recorded at Changi, above January's average monthly rainfall.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: From 10 January to 11 January, a total of 255.2 millimetres of rainfall was recorded at Changi, which is more than our average monthly rainfall of 222.4 millimetres in January.

sections.label: Drainage investment and flood prone areas
sections.summary: About $2.5 billion spent since 2011 reduced flood prone areas from about 3,200 hectares in the 1970s to under 25 hectares.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: The Government has made significant investments over the decades to upgrade drainage infrastructure, with about $2.5 billion spent since 2011.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: We have successfully reduced flood prone areas from approximately 3,200 hectares in the 1970s to less than 25 hectares today.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: PUB conducts regular reviews on the adequacy of the existing drainage system and considers the latest drainage design standards and climate change data.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: There are 19 ongoing drainage upgrading works, with six more projects slated to commence in 2025.

sections.label: Flood warnings and drainage review
sections.summary: LTA is working to make warnings more effective, and the flood drainage system will be reviewed with coastal protection for 2026 to 2030.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: We are also working with the Land Transport Authority (LTA) to make some of these warning ahead of time more effectively through more platforms.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: And in the longer term, we will want to review our flood drainage system, in tandem with our coastal protection system, because these are two sides of the same coin.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: It is really to bring consideration, at the same time, plan for it and be prepared to invest in effective infrastructure that we have said that we are going to invest in significantly.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: We will review the plans, as I have said earlier on, for the next cycle of 2026 to 2030.

sections.label: High resolution flood forecasts
sections.summary: Work is ongoing with NEA and the Meteorological Service Singapore for more sensors and better modelling in flood projection.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: So, it is all the more important for us to get very high resolution of forecasts in the very near term.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: So, that is something that we are working on, including with NEA and the Meteorological Service Singapore to have more sensors and better modelling in flood projection.

sections.label: One significant flood incident
sections.summary: In the most recent monsoon surges, there was only one significant reported flood incident.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: As I have mentioned, in the most recent monsoon surges, we only had one significant reported flood incident.
